_note: Synthetic notification batch (corpus google-fitbit.md §10: batched messages carrying health user, operation UPSERT/DELETE, data type and record/interval/version). `body` is what Google POSTs; google_test.ts serialises it and signs those exact bytes with a test-generated P-256 key (the keyset is generated in the test, not stored here). VERIFY: the batch envelope (array vs {messages:[]}), the message-id field (`messageId` assumed; the second message has none so the adapter derives the user|dataType|record@version triple), `data.dataPointName`, `data.version`, `data.intervals[].physicalTimeInterval`.
